title: Customer Experience Associate
description:
Customer Experience Associate CX (Customer Experience) | 1+ years | Full Time | Bangalore 
 Who are we? Kapture CX is a leading SaaS platform that helps enterprises automate and elevate customer experience through intelligent, AI-powered solutions. We partner with enterprises across industries to bring scalable automation and insight-driven efficiencies to their CX operations. Over a thousand clients across 18 countries have used Kaptures products to enhance their customer experience, including Unilever, Reliance, Coca-Cola, BigBasket, Meesho, Airtel Payments Bank and Cathay Pacific. Kapture delivers industry-specific solutions powered by AI, tailored workflows, and seamless automation.Kapture CX is headquartered in Bangalore and has offices in Mumbai and Delhi/NCR in India, in addition to offices in the USA, UAE, Singapore, Philippines and Indonesia. 
 What is this role all about? As a Customer Experience Associate , you will be the first line of support for customers, helping resolve their queries and routine technical issues while ensuring a smooth support experience. You will manage support requests, troubleshoot issues, collaborate with relevant CX and technical teams, and build an understanding of customer workflows and use cases.The role combines customer engagement, technical troubleshooting, ticket management and cross-functional collaboration to ensure customer issues are addressed accurately and within defined service levels.
 Sounds interesting? Heres what you will do in this role: Client Engagement Provide first-line support to customers by understanding their queries, workflows and use cases. Manage customer support requests and provide clear, professional and context-aware responses. Gather relevant information about reported issues and share accurate details with the appropriate internal teams. Collaborate with CX and technical stakeholders to ensure customer concerns are addressed effectively. Build customer trust through timely communication and solution-oriented support. 
 Technical Expertise Troubleshoot routine application and platform-related issues by checking configurations and identifying basic technical problems. Support API and integration-related queries and escalate complex technical issues with complete and relevant information. Reproduce and document issues where required and raise BUGs/CRs on JIRA for further investigation. Work with L2, Customer Engineering and relevant technical teams to support timely issue resolution. Maintain and update knowledge base articles, FAQs and troubleshooting documentation to improve support quality. 
 Project & Delivery Management Manage assigned support requests by tracking ticket progress, maintaining accurate updates and ensuring timely follow-up. Prioritise support requests based on urgency and defined SLAs. Escalate critical or complex issues to the appropriate teams and follow them through to resolution. Follow defined SOPs and support processes to ensure consistent service delivery. Collaborate with relevant teams on issue resolution and operational follow-ups. 
 Business Acumen & Problem Solving Use basic ticket data and support metrics to identify recurring issues and patterns. Develop an understanding of customer workflows and how platform issues impact their operations. Apply structured problem-solving to identify relevant information before escalating an issue. Share recurring customer or operational issues with relevant teams to support improvements in the customer experience. 
 What does success look like in this role? Success in this role means providing timely and accurate support, meeting defined SLAs, maintaining high-quality ticket documentation, and ensuring customer issues are followed through to appropriate resolution .You will also be expected to build a strong understanding of Kapture’s platform and customer workflows, collaborate effectively with internal teams, and contribute to improving support processes and knowledge resources. 
 What would make you a good fit for this role? Basic Requirements 1+ years of experience in Customer Experience, technical support, helpdesk or a similar role, preferably in a SaaS or CRM environment. Comfortable working with ticketing tools such as Freshdesk and managing multiple support requests. Good understanding of basic application and technical troubleshooting. Ability to understand customer queries, gather relevant information and document issues clearly. Good written and verbal communication skills. Ability to manage priorities and follow defined SLAs and support processes. Strong ownership and follow-through on assigned customer issues. 
 What are the most critical skills for this role? Customer focus: Ability to understand customer concerns and provide clear, empathetic and solution-oriented support. Technical troubleshooting: Ability to investigate routine technical issues and identify the information required for further debugging. Problem solving: Ability to analyse issues logically, reproduce problems where required and document findings clearly. Technical understanding: Basic exposure to APIs, integrations and application workflows. Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with CX, L2, Customer Engineering and other internal teams. Time and priority management: Ability to manage multiple support requests while maintaining service quality and SLA adherence.

title: Inventory Executive
description:
Stores & Inventory Executive Industrial Products 
 Location: Thiruverkadu, Chennai
 Employment Type: Full-time
 Number of Openings: 2
 Nature of Work: On-site stores and inventory management at a single Mcvan office location 
 Working Days and Hours: Monday-Saturday 9.30 AM to 5.30 PM 
 About Mcvan Industrial Corporation Founded in 1990, Mcvan Industrial Corporation is an established industrial products and engineering-support company based in Chennai. We work with leading industrial brands and serve customers across manufacturing, automotive and other engineering sectors. 
 Our key product areas include: SMC Pneumatic and industrial automation products Magnaflux Non-destructive testing products and equipment Bradma Industrial marking and traceability solutions 
 Mcvan is also expanding its capabilities in industrial automation and integrated engineering solutions. 
 About the Role: We are looking for two organised and dependable Stores & Inventory Executives to manage our extensive inventory of industrial products, components and accessories. 
 The role involves receiving and checking materials, organising stock, maintaining accurate inventory records, preparing orders and coordinating dispatches. Candidates must be comfortable handling physical stock and recording transactions using Tally or Zoho tools . 
 Our products include many similar-looking items with different part numbers and technical specifications. Accuracy, attention to detail and a willingness to learn our product ranges are essential. 
 This position is based at a single Mcvan office and stores location in Chennai. 
 Key Responsibilities Receive incoming materials and verify quantities, part numbers and condition against purchase orders and supplier documents. Record material receipts, stock issues, dispatches and returns accurately and promptly in the inventory system. Label and arrange products systematically in designated racks, bins and storage locations. Maintain accurate item details, units of measure and storage-location records. Pick and pack customer orders, checking product codes, quantities and accessories before dispatch. Prepare or coordinate delivery challans, packing lists and other dispatch documents with the accounts and sales teams. Coordinate with transporters and courier partners for timely collection and delivery. Conduct regular physical stock counts and reconcile differences with system records. Report shortages, excess stock, damaged goods, incorrect supplies and inventory discrepancies promptly. Monitor low-stock, slow-moving and non-moving items and inform the relevant team. Track batches, serial numbers and expiry dates wherever applicable. Handle customer returns and supplier returns with proper documentation. Maintain a clean, orderly and accessible stores area and follow product-specific storage and handling instructions. Coordinate with sales, purchase, accounts and service teams regarding stock availability and order requirements. 
 Educational Qualification: Candidates should preferably possess a Diploma , particularly in: Mechanical Engineering Mechatronics Engineering Electrical and Electronics Engineering Automobile Engineering A related technical discipline 
 Candidates without a diploma may also be considered if they have relevant practical experience in stores, inventory control or industrial-material handling. 
 Candidate Requirements: Practical experience using Tally or Zoho tools for inventory transactions and stock records . Ability to identify and verify products using part numbers, descriptions, sizes and specifications. Strong attention to detail when counting, recording, picking and dispatching materials. Basic computer skills, including spreadsheets, email and document handling. Ability to maintain organised records and investigate stock differences. Working proficiency in Tamil and sufficient English to read product descriptions, documents and emails. Willingness to carry out routine physical stock handling, packing and stores organisation. A reliable, responsible approach to company stock and documentation. Ability to coordinate with colleagues and manage daily priorities. 
 Preferred Experience The following will be considered an advantage: Previous experience in stores, inventory management, warehousing or dispatch. Experience with industrial distributors, engineering companies, spare-parts suppliers or manufacturing stores. Familiarity with pneumatic components, automation products, NDT consumables or industrial marking products. Experience managing a large number of product codes and similar-looking components. Knowledge of stock reconciliation, bin-location systems, barcode scanning and batch or serial-number tracking. Experience handling shelf-life-sensitive consumables and following applicable storage instructions. 
 Product Familiarisation and Compensation The role requires learning Mcvan’s product codes, storage arrangements, inventory procedures and dispatch requirements across SMC, Magnaflux, Bradma and other product lines. Salary will be based on the candidate’s relevant experience, inventory-management skills and ability to handle the responsibilities of the role. Candidates should apply with their updated rsum, current location, educational qualification, relevant work experience, inventory software used, expected salary and earliest possible joining date .
